mapper.select: select t.topic_id, t.title, t.summary, t.cover_url, t.bundle_price, t.download_count, t.order_num, t.bundle_document_id, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, (select count(1) from edu_library_topic_document td inner join edu_library_document d on d.document_id = td.document_id and d.del_flag = '0' where td.topic_id = t.topic_id) as doc_count from edu_library_topic t where t.topic_id = #{topicId} and t.del_flag = '0'

select t.topic_id, t.title, t.summary, t.cover_url, t.bundle_price, t.download_count, t.order_num, t.bundle_document_id, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, (select count(1) from edu_library_topic_document td inner join edu_library_document d on d.document_id = td.document_id and d.del_flag = '0' where td.topic_id = t.topic_id) as doc_count from edu_library_topic t
t.del_flag = '0' and t.title like ('%' || #{title} || '%') and t.status = #{status}
and t.status = '0' and exists ( select 1 from edu_library_topic_document td inner join edu_library_document d on d.document_id = td.document_id where td.topic_id = t.topic_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.audit_status = '1' )
order by t.order_num, t.topic_id desc
mapper.update:
update edu_library_topic
title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, bundle_price = #{bundlePrice}, order_num = #{orderNum}, bundle_document_id = #{bundleDocumentId}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
where topic_id = #{topicId} and del_flag = '0'

insert into edu_library_topic_document (topic_id, document_id, order_num) values
(#{topicId}, #{documentId}, #{idx})
mapper.update: update edu_library_topic set download_count = download_count + 1 where topic_id = #{topicId}
